entities.summary: Jae-gyun Hwang is a South Korean former professional baseball infielder. He played in the KBO League for the Hyundai Unicorns, Nexen Heroes, Lotte Giants, and KT Wiz, and in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Francisco Giants.
